US-001.title: Developer deploys changes via pull request

US-003.title: End user views beach conditions with low latency

US-004.title: System maintains fresh data via scheduled refresh

AC-001.description: When a pull request is opened or updated, the CI pipeline shall run lint, type-check, and test steps

AC-002.description: If all CI checks pass, then the pipeline shall deploy a preview to a unique Cloudflare Pages URL

AC-003.description: If any CI check fails, then the pipeline shall block the preview deployment and report the failure

AC-004.description: When a pull request preview is deployed, the preview URL shall be posted as a comment or status check on the PR

AC-005.description: When a commit is pushed to the master branch, the CI pipeline shall run lint, type-check, and test steps

AC-006.description: If all CI checks pass on master, then the pipeline shall deploy to the production Cloudflare Pages environment

AC-007.description: If any CI check fails on master, then the pipeline shall not deploy and shall notify the team of the failure

AC-008.description: The production deployment shall be accessible at vanbeaches.com within 5 minutes of a successful pipeline run

AC-009.description: While cached data exists in KV, the API shall return responses in < 200ms at the 95th percentile

AC-010.description: When the dashboard loads, the system shall serve the SPA from edge locations via Cloudflare Pages

AC-011.description: If cached data is missing for a beach, then the API shall fetch from the upstream source and return the result within < 3 seconds

AC-012.description: The system shall refresh weather data for all 9 beaches every 30 minutes via a cron trigger

AC-013.description: The system shall refresh tide data for all unique tide stations every 60 minutes via a cron trigger

AC-014.description: The system shall refresh water quality data for all 9 beaches every 6 hours via a cron trigger

AC-015.description: While operating on the free tier, the system shall consume fewer than 1,000 KV writes per day (Target: < 700 writes/day)

AC-016.description: If an upstream API call fails during a scheduled refresh, then the system shall log the error and continue refreshing remaining beaches

AC-017.description: When the developer runs the local dev command, the system shall serve both the SPA and API functions locally

AC-018.description: While developing locally, the developer shall be able to make changes to functions and see them reflected without restarting

AC-019.description: The local development experience shall not require a Cloudflare account or network access to Cloudflare services for basic development

ADR-001.title: Use Cloudflare Pages + Functions + KV + Cron Triggers over Vercel or keeping Express
ADR-001.rationale: Eliminates infrastructure management, free tier covers workload, KV maps directly to existing cache pattern, co-located SPA+API in one project

NG-005: Adding new features or data sources
NG-007: Migrating to D1 relational database
